messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: High error rate and tail latency observed for tenant 'juno' in the juno-enterprise VPC. Affected: dedicated-us-east-3 pool. Trigger: 5xx rate >10% and p95 latency >2s for 3m. Paging oncall @maya. Ops bridge: https://ops.redwood/bridge/1819987654
maya: oncall ack. I'm pulling logs and checking pool health. starting with node-level metrics and recent deploys.
omar (sre): joining bridge. I'll check infra alarms and any autoscaler events. saw a spike in network errors on one GPU node a few mins ago.
kai: i'm here, looking at model-serving logs for juno tenant. seeing many "KV cache miss" + retry bursts, a lot of regen requests. possible noisy tenant causing head-of-line.
maya: can we isolate juno first to stop blast radius? suggests eviction if necessary.
kai: preparing isolation runbook. plan: 1) reroute new requests for tenant to fallback pool (shared-fallback) 2) gracefully evict active sessions from dedicated-us-east-3 3) unblock other tenants. Command I'm about to run:
```
rwinfctl tenant isolate --tenant-id juno --from-pool dedicated-us-east-3 --target-pool shared-fallback --grace-period 30s
```
eli (eng-lead): hold on on eviction until we confirm user-visible errors. ops metrics show error rate concentrated on inference proxy 3. if we evict, we'll also trigger rollbacks for pinned model version. we need customer comm first.
tara (custops): i'm drafting a quick note to Juno CSM and their infra lead. going to ask whether they want us to proceed with isolation immediately or wait for their input. pinging them now.
pm-anna: tagging execs — if this becomes prolonged we may need an interim exec note. pls keep timeline and customer impact short.
kai: starting traffic drain now (will let active websockets finish, 30s). running the command.
maya: eviction in progress. bridge: https://ops.redwood/bridge/1819987654
kai: eviction command output: `drain started: 12 sessions, 3 workers quarantined`
omar (sre): meanwhile I swapped the load-balancer weight off of node gpu-03 which had high network retransmits. monitoring.
kai: after isolation p95 dropped to 380ms for non-juno tenants, overall 5xx down to 0.8%. juno still has retries on fallback pool but rate limited.
tara (custops): customer convo: "We're seeing errors in production since 11:34, appreciate the fast action. Please proceed with isolation. We'll take the fallback traffic plan." they requested a one-line note for their oncall.
eli (eng-lead): good. next: collect artifacts for RCA. Kai - capture: last 30m proxy logs, GPU node metrics, tenant request traces, and any deploy activity in the last 2 hours. Maya - can you capture oncall notes and paging timeline? Omar - please snapshot autoscaler and LB events.
maya: ack, saving notes to incident doc: https://redwood/doc/incidents/1819987654-juno-notes
kai: exporting logs now. snippet of error pattern: `error=kv_cache_miss, retries=3, reason=ttl_evicted` looks like cache churn + regen storms from a backlog of long contexts.
eli (eng-lead): hypothesis: a customer workload with long-context requests caused KV cache pressure; combined with a noisy tenant burst triggered retries causing head-of-line for the dedicated pool. mitigation: isolate tenant + throttle their ingress and enable model-variant fallback (re-quantized variant) for fallback pool.
omar (sre): I've put a temporary throttle at the edge: `rate-limit: tenant=juno, 10rps` — reduces regen pressure while customer's team reviews.
tara (custops): customer asked about credits and SLA impact. current impact window ~11:34-11:46 (12m) for other tenants — service degradation for some p95 only before isolation. Juno impacted longer but is on fallback.
pm-anna: please prepare an internal exec brief doc for EOD summarizing impact, mitigation, customer ask, and recommended credit. propose: 1 day Dedicated credit + one technical postmortem session.
kai: creating RCA draft in docs: https://redwood/docs/rca/drafts/juno-tenant-1819987654.md — will include timeline, root cause hypothesis, remediation, and followups (cache TTL tuning, ingress throttles, tenant rate limits, autoscaler target tweaks).
maya: post-incident actions: - schedule RCA review w/eng + custops (owner: kai) - propose temporary quota for juno (owner: tara) - validate autoscaler thresholds (owner: omar) - update runbook to include quick-eviction steps and fallback promotion (owner: maya)
tara (custops): i'll coordinate customer comm: send exec summary + ask for permission to apply agreed credits. will include ETA for RCA draft (tomorrow EOD).
eli (eng-lead): thank you. once RCA draft is ready, we'll prepare an exec one-pager for their CTO. keep the thread alive for any followups.
omar (sre): marking incident as mitigated for other tenants at 11:46. keeping monitoring for 1h.
kai: logging final mitigation note: isolation succeeded, fallback pool accepted traffic, rediscovered cache policy issues. will propose a cache-size bump and TTL change in the next deployment.
maya: closing active pager. created follow-up ticket: INF-4821 (juno tenant postmortem & remediation).
tara (custops): customer confirmed they are available for a 30m post-incident call tomorrow 10:00am PT. I'll send calendar invite. :white_check_mark:
pm-anna: thanks team — please update the RCA draft link when done. we'll review before sending credits proposal to finance.
incident-bot: Incident resolved status: mitigated (impact restricted to tenant 'juno' on fallback). Summary: isolation + edge throttle + LB weight adjust. Incident duration: ~12m for cross-tenant impact.
